purpose: CAL experiment B1: the +-NDEBUG RCCL A/B. Same source tree, one line apart, both measured on the atomics-enabled box.
host: VM 101, the VFIO guest, RX 7900 XT pair, TP=2

source.upstream: ROCm/rccl release/rocm-rel-7.1.1.1, --depth 1, so no .git and no commit to quote

configure.note: -DROCM_PATH was not needed by the 2026-07 build; the CMake variable defaults to /opt/rocm, which does not exist in this wheel-SDK image, so CMakeLists.txt:191 died reading /opt/rocm/.info/version. Why it resolved in July and not now is not established.

post_build: both arms took the identical patchelf treatment build-rccl-nohostcall.sh applies: --remove-needed librocm_smi64.so.1, --add-needed librsmi_stub.so.1. Their NEEDED lists are identical.

measurement.sweeps: three per arm, INTERLEAVED A B A B A B; the library is reinstalled and md5-asserted before each
measurement.script: b1/allreduce.py, md5 4503492023cb2dcb845c1843730fa0da -- benchmarks/allreduce-2026-09-02/allreduce.py with the hostcall detector fixed; the 09-02 campaign's own copy was left untouched
measurement.round1: one sweep per arm, ar-*.jsonl, kept. Its ar_meta records hostcall 0 for BOTH arms: a false negative from the CCOB-compressed fatbin, which is what prompted the detector fix and round 2.
measurement.lease: held; ollama and llamacpp-hub stopped 18:47:59, restarted 18:52:13, both cards verified back to 27971584

atomics_precondition: asserted before stopping anything: no 'PCIE atomic ops is not supported' in dmesg. Both root ports above the GPUs report AtomicOpsCap: 32bit+ 64bit+.

decode.purpose: B1's end-to-end half: 2 models x 3 depths x 5 repeats, both arms
decode.serve: vllm serve --tensor-parallel-size 2 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --max-model-len 33000, env VLLM_CLONE_MMAP=1 NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 HSA_ENABLE_SDMA=0
decode.request_shape: identical to benchmarks/campaign-2026-09-03/runner.py chat(): streaming, random seed prefix, temperature 0.8, decode_tps = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first)
decode.sessions: four, because librccl cannot be swapped under a running server. Order BALANCED across models: G12 ndebug then nondebug, Q8 nondebug then ndebug.
decode.attribution: each session read the SERVING process's /proc/<pid>/maps and md5'd the mapped librccl against the arm's; all four matched, and a mismatch aborts the session rather than producing a mislabelled row
decode.vram_between_sessions: re-asserted to 27971584 on both cards after every serve stop, because pkill'd vLLM leaves [VLLM::Worker_TP] children holding memory
decode.known_confound: prefill differences follow SESSION ORDER, not arm: the second session of a pair is faster in three of four interpretable cells, and the one cell with a significant separation (Q8 32000, p=0.008) is the largest order effect. Resolving it needs a server restart per repeat and was not done.
